title: Limit hover-track bend to 45° and reduce traveling glow intensity

requirements.text: Adjust the ElectronHoverLink (PCB track) path routing so the connection track does not “turn” excessively and all bends remain natural with a maximum bend angle of 45° (i.e., only horizontal/vertical segments connected by 45° diagonals, without additional sharper turns or overly aggressive detours).

quotes: here you are turning the track so much reduce and make them usual of max 45 degree

acceptanceCriteria: When hovering a category, the rendered connection track only uses straight horizontal/vertical segments and 45° diagonal transitions (no sharper-than-45° corners).
Compared to the current behavior, the track path shows visibly less exaggerated turning/detouring between origin and target across typical screen sizes.
The effect still renders correctly during hover and during the existing fade-out behavior (no flicker, no broken path).

requirements.text: Slightly reduce the intensity of the ElectronHoverLink glowing/moving visuals (the traveling glow segment and glow head), while preserving the same overall style and timing.

quotes: and slightly reduce th intensity of the glowing and moving part.

acceptanceCriteria: The traveling glow trail appears subtly dimmer/less intense than before (lower perceived brightness), without disappearing.
The moving glow head is also slightly less intense than before while remaining clearly visible.
Static track rendering (solid + dashed) and fade-in/fade-out behavior continue to work as they do currently.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep changes limited to the existing ElectronHoverLink hover-connection effect; do not introduce new hover behaviors or unrelated UI changes.
nonGoals: Changing hover transition timing for category text or other non-track UI elements.
